rules.name: server_not_reporting
rules.summary: Server A has sent no metrics for 5 minutes: it is down, or its VPN link to B is cut. Check the Iranian site from inside Iran.

rules.name: server_b_not_reporting
rules.summary: Server B's own exporter is not reporting.

rules.name: site_health_failing
rules.summary: the site's own health checks are failing (see the next alert for which one)

rules.name: health_check_failed
rules.summary: health check '{check}' fails

rules.name: probe_failed
rules.summary: {instance} does not answer

rules.name: target_down
rules.summary: metrics target {job}/{instance} is down

rules.name: deployment_unavailable
rules.summary: deployment {deployment} is missing {value} replica(s)

rules.name: pod_problem
rules.summary: pod {pod} is stuck: {reason}

rules.name: pod_restarting
rules.summary: {pod}/{container} restarted {value} times in 30 minutes

rules.name: k8s_collector_down
rules.summary: cannot read Kubernetes state on this server

rules.name: cpu_high
rules.summary: CPU {value}% for 10 minutes

rules.name: load_high
rules.summary: load average {value} on 8 CPUs for 3 minutes

rules.name: memory_low
rules.summary: only {value}% memory available: a few heavy queries can now exhaust the server (look at pg_stat_activity and pod memory)

rules.name: memory_critical
rules.summary: only {value}% memory available: the kernel will start killing processes

rules.name: swap_high
rules.summary: swap {value}% used

rules.name: disk_high
rules.summary: disk {value}% full

rules.name: disk_critical
rules.summary: disk {value}% full: Kubernetes evicts pods above about 85-90%

rules.name: postgres_connections
rules.summary: {value} database connections (limit 120)

rules.name: sync_batches_in_error
rules.summary: {value} {direction} replication batch(es) stuck in error: data is NOT being copied between the servers

rules.name: sync_stalled
rules.summary: batches are waiting to be sent but none moved for {value}s: replication is stuck (an idle system with nothing to send is NOT an alert)

rules.name: sync_backlog
rules.summary: the oldest undelivered outgoing replication batch is {value}s old

rules.name: sync_state_unreadable
rules.summary: cannot read the replication state from the database

rules.name: db_sync_lag
rules.summary: database sync lag {value}s

rules.name: file_sync_stale
rules.summary: the two-way file/image sync has not succeeded for {value}s

rules.name: certificate_expiring
rules.summary: certificate expires in {value} days

rules.name: backup_too_old
rules.summary: newest {kind} backup is {value}s old (limit 26 h)

rules.name: backup_storage_too_old
rules.summary: newest object-storage backup is {value}s old

rules.name: offsite_copy_too_old
rules.summary: the encrypted copy to the other server is {value}s old (limit 9 h)

rules.name: restore_test_too_old
rules.summary: no successful restore test for {value}s (weekly job)

rules.name: jenkins_build_failed
rules.summary: the last build of {exported_job} FAILED

rules.name: jenkins_repeated_failures
rules.summary: {exported_job}: {value} builds failed in a row

rules.name: sms_provider_login_failed
rules.summary: MeliPayamak (SMS OTP for Iranian numbers) rejects our login or is unreachable: login SMS will fail

rules.name: sms_credit_low
rules.summary: MeliPayamak SMS credit is low: {value}

rules.name: provider_unreachable
rules.summary: cannot open a connection to {provider}'s API

rules.name: provider_send_errors
rules.summary: {provider}: {value} failed sends and no successful one in 15 minutes (real user OTPs are failing)

rules.name: vpn_down
rules.summary: the VPN tunnel from server A to B is down or cannot reach B:443: database/file sync and metrics from A are cut

rules.name: vpn_service_down
rules.summary: VPN service {unit} is not running on A

rules.name: vpn_packet_loss
rules.summary: VPN link loses {value}% of packets

rules.name: vpn_slow
rules.summary: VPN round trip is {value} ms (normal ~130)

rules.name: oom_kill
rules.summary: the kernel killed {value} process(es) for lack of memory in the last 15 minutes: the server is in memory trouble (journalctl -k | grep -i oom)

rules.name: memory_pressure
rules.summary: processes wait for memory {value} of the time: the server is thrashing and about to stop answering (SSH included)

rules.name: swap_thrash
rules.summary: {value} pages/s are moving to and from swap: the server is short of memory

rules.name: load_extreme
rules.summary: load average {value}: the server is overloaded and may stop answering

rules.name: long_running_query
rules.summary: a database query has been running for {value}s (not a backup or replication job? check pg_stat_activity)

rules.name: release_behind
rules.summary: server A has not applied B's latest release for 30 minutes (lsevin-release-sync on A; log /var/log/lsevin-release-sync.log)

rules.name: release_check_failing
rules.summary: server A cannot read B's release manifest for {value}s: new publishes will not reach A (VPN down? B's /_releases route or password?)
